notes.published_settings: 250 epochs; Adam 1e-3; LR halving every 50 scheduler steps; 100 simulations; five predicted frames per backward; relative LP loss; range [-1,1]; FNO modes32 width64 layers6 GELU; Euler for NODE/OpsSplit.
notes.repository_details: Batch20 and seed907 follow NS_spectral_FNO.yaml. Adam weight_decay1e-4, default betas(0.9,0.999), epoch-wise scheduler and effective gradient clip1 follow Expts/Train.py / Utils/explicit_time.py; the YAML clip2 is not passed to that trainer.
notes.es_adaptations: 100 training trajectories plus existing independent family-held-out validation/test; first50 stored frames for training/normalization, remaining frames for temporal extrapolation; fieldwise train-only minmax; four channels; saved-frame dt1; nonperiodic padded FNO and interior cylindrical FD. Whole epoch traverses every sliding window once without replacement.
notes.opsplit: Native JOREK formulation uses orchestrate_native.py and train_native_rollout.py: primary rho,p,u,(psi), separate term pretraining, anchored five-step loss, implicit diffusion/momentum, reported positivity-backtracked corrections. These are explicit adaptations from the paper Euler solver. See native_readiness.json. Baseline run snapshots remain unchanged.
notes.implementation_resolution: Paper takes precedence over older YAML (lr0.005, scheduler100) and trainer (range[0,1], rollout_length-1). Exactly five predictions here. Channels differ from incompressible NS; padded neuralop1.0.2 backend, lifting width64 and projection256; parameter counts recorded, not asserted equal to published counts.
notes.legacy_opsplit: One six-layer fluid FNO plus four learned, bounded effective scalar diffusivities. Matches the incompressible single-neural-block layout; does not import the compressible two-three-layer-block convection/divergence equations into JOREK. This is an effective split, not identification of physical JOREK RHS terms.
